    },

        'function': 'pixFewColorsOctcubeQuantMixed',
        'line': 3306,
        'var': 'pixc->depth',

        'note': 'pixc has depth 4 bpp, but subsequent code treats it as 8 bpp'
    },

        'file': 'src/colorquant1.c',
        'function': 'pixFewColorsOctcubeQuantMixed',
        'line': 3306,
        'var': 'linec',
        'code': 'linec = (l_uint8 *)pixGetData(pixc) + y * pixGetWpl(pixc) * 4',
        'note': 'linec points to row data with wpl*4 bytes per row for 4 bpp'
    },
    {
        'step': 6,
        'file': 'src/colorquant1.c',
        'function': 'pixFewColorsOctcubeQuantMixed',
        'line': 3306,
        'var': 'val',
        'code': 'val = GET_DATA_BYTE(linec, j)',
        'note': 'Reads byte at offset j from linec; for 4 bpp data, valid offsets are 0..wpl*4-1, but j iterates 0..w-1, causing heap-buffer-overflow when j >= wpl*4'
    }
]

print('Trace written')
